hero.eyebrow: Cox Mill High School · Concord, NC
hero.headline: Good things happen when we lead together.
hero.description: The people, moments, and ideas bringing our school together. This is Cox Mill Leadership.

mission.heading: A little initiative. A lasting impact.
mission.description: We bring students together through school spirit, thoughtful events, and service. Leadership is about showing up, listening, and making Cox Mill a place where everyone can belong.

about.heading: Leadership starts with us.
about.intro: A class with a purpose: bringing our school community together.
about.body:
Cox Mill Leadership is a place to turn ideas into action. Students help plan experiences, celebrate school spirit, and create opportunities to serve the community.

From the first planning conversation to the final cleanup, leadership means collaboration, responsibility, and care for the people around us.
about.participation: Bring your ideas, join school activities, and look for opportunities shared through school-approved channels. Ask the leadership advisor at school about current ways to participate.

contact.intro: Have an idea for our school? Want to take part? Start with the school office or an approved opportunity below.
contact.opportunities: Volunteer opportunities and school-approved sign-up forms will be shared here when available. You can also ask the leadership advisor at school.

footerMessage: Made for the moments that bring us together.
